title.rendered: Ajanta Bottle is an important part of the Valentia family – Pankaj Sharma, Valentia Organic Farms

content.rendered:
Thank you so much @Pankaj Sharma Valentia Organic farms for your kind words and valuable feedback for Ajanta Bottle Pvt Ltd

We are delighted to know that Ajanta Bottle has become an important part of the Valentia family. Our association has strengthened in the past 10 years. Looking forward to a much more stronger association in the decades to come.

All the best Valentia Organic farms!

To know more about Valentia Farms, visit https://zcu.io/rhee

To see Ajanta Bottle Pvt Ltd entire collection of glass bottles and glass jars and place order online, visit https://zcu.io/2nk3
